LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_CinderBloodline.label: (Raven) Polymer Regeneration (Minor)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_CinderBloodline.description:
A special bloodline branch from the Cinder race. The bearer's cells are partially replaced by polymer-like substances, allowing the bearer to slowly repair damaged tissue and even regenerate missing limbs.

Effects:
- Gains regeneration (checked every 600 ticks)
- Incoming damage multiplier x0.9
- Flammability x0.8
